text: The cheapest model scored 19.7% on a hard research test. Give it an advisor, and it jumps to 41.2%.
say: The cheapest model... scored nineteen point seven percent on a hard research test. Give it an advisor... and it jumps to forty-one point two percent.

text: Here's the trick. The small, fast model does all the work: it writes the code, runs it, and reads the files.

text: The big model never touches the keyboard. It only steps in at the hard parts: before picking a plan, when the same error keeps coming back, and before calling the job done.
say: The big model never touches the keyboard. It only steps in at the hard parts. Before picking a plan. When the same error keeps coming back. And before calling the job done.

text: It's Anthropic's advisor strategy, and it's built right into Claude Code. One command: /advisor opus.
